meta.name: google-ads-audit
meta.description: Google Ads account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", "what should I fix in my ads", or when the user is new to NotFair and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other ads skills detect that business-context.json is missing.

copy.tagline: 审计谷歌广告账户并设置业务上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理谷歌广告账户并需要快速了解账户健康状况。
copy.tagline_en: Audit your Google Ads account and set up business context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and need a quick health overview.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会审计你的 Google Ads 账户:只读不修改,收集业务信息,分析账户健康,生成浪费金额、需求捕获、每次转化成本三项指标和诊断报告,并保存上下文文件供其他广告技能复用。
howto.when: 当你说「audit my ads」「ads audit」「set up my ads」等触发词,或你是 NotFair 新用户、尚未跑过审计时触发;其他广告技能发现上下文文件缺失时也会主动触发。

say.note: 触发完整审计,输出三项指标和报告。
缩小审计范围,聚焦指定系列。

say.text: 我的账户现在要不要停投?
say.note: 若转化跟踪有问题,它会建议先暂停花费。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits your Google Ads account using read-only operations. It gathers business info, analyzes account health, generates three pulse metrics (waste, demand captured, CPA) plus a report, and saves context files that other ads skills reuse.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", etc., or when you're new to NotFair and haven't run an audit. Also fires when other ads skills detect business-context.json is missing.

say_en.note: Runs a full audit and produces the report.
Scopes the audit to that campaign.
Flags measurement issues if conversion tracking is broken.
